test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The ship sank because the engineer __has not called for help__.
solution:
The correct answer is- "**did not call for help**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"did not call for help"** is the most appropriate option to be substituted.
 
• The given sentence is in simple past tense, thus, did not call for help is to be substituted.
 
• Thus, ***option 2)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the structure of negative and positive sentences in simple past tense.

 
• **Positive Form:**
 
• Subject + V2 ( Second Form of Verb
 
 
• Example: She came back. 
 
 
 
• **Negative Form:**
 
• Subject + did not + V1 ( First Form of Verb )
 
 
• **Example:** She did not come back.
 
 
 
• **Interrogative Form:**
 
• Did + Subject + V1 ( First Form of Verb )
 
 
• **Example:** Did she come back?
